newsitem.title: UK: Most US stocks ease in London, tech stocks weigh.
newsitem.headline: Most US stocks ease in London, tech stocks weigh.

text.p: U.S. stocks eased in London on Thursday, weighed down by the technology sector, dealers said.
Dealers here were expecting Wall Street to open a bit lower after the Dow, which came within striking distance of the 8,000 mark on Monday, closed 119.88 points lower at 7,842.43.
"There was some disappointment that the Dow didn't get through 8,000 and I think we're in for a bit more consolidation," said one London dealer.
"Tech shares are very jumpy. No one seems to know which way to take them," he added.
Shares in Seagate Technology Inc tumbled $1-1/4 in London to $37-3/4 as the group posted disappointing results for its fiscal fourth quarter after Wall Street closed.

Shares in COMPAQ Computer Corp eased $5/8 to $120-1/2 on profit-taking ahead of the release of the group's second quarter results later in the day. Press reports that Compaq plans to cut prices on personal computers in the U.S. also weighed.
Shares in Hewlett-Packard Co fell $13/16 to $57-1/8 on press reports that the company also plans price reductions, dealers said.
Shares in Motorola Inc slipped $1/2 to $85-1/2 on profit-taking following a big rally on the back of the group's strong second quarter earnings, they said.
In other trading, September S&P 500 futures were down 1.00 point at 917.00 on Globex at 1038 GMT. September long bond futures were down 3/32 at 113-26/32.
